notes.subject: 2027 provider opportunity - Mukilteo Lighthouse Festival
notes.body: 2026 Mukilteo Lighthouse Festival is Sept. 11-13 at Lighthouse Park, 609 Front Street, Mukilteo WA. Official festival site says 2026 booth applications are closed and lists info@mukfest.com / 425-353-5516. Use a 2027 provider-introduction angle rather than trying to enter the current 2026 vendor setup. Washington is weather-restricted, not on hold; lead with prepaid. Old Farmer's Almanac currently shows showers then sunny/cool Sept. 11-17 in the Pacific Northwest, reinforcing prepaid as the safer primary model. No Adventure Zone Gmail history was found. Sources verified Aug. 27, 2026: mukfest.com, City of Mukilteo, Old Farmer's Almanac.

followUps.label: 2027 provider intro follow-up
followUps.reason: After the 2027 introduction draft is sent, follow up with the festival association if they have not replied. Lead with prepaid because of Washington weather risk; pay-for-play remains a secondary approved option.
